page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-192-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 1512.0 GB of RAM. This configuration yields approximately 7.88 GB of memory per core, providing a balanced ratio of compute power to memory capacity for high-scale workloads.

A primary characteristic of this server type is its integrated high-capacity local storage. It is bundled with 45097 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 12 local SSD drives. This massive storage array is designed for low-latency, high-throughput data access. The instance does not include any graphics processing units, making it entirely reliant on its 192 dedicated x86_64 CPU cores for processing tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-192-standardlssd offers high resource density by combining massive local NVMe storage with a substantial memory footprint on a single instance. This design reduces the need for external storage attachments, optimizing data transfer costs and latency. This server is suited for large-scale databases, high-performance storage systems, big data analytics, and memory-intensive transactional processing workloads that require rapid access to vast local datasets.
